findings.title: Close mint ignores SingleAssetVault queue
findings.description: The vulnerability exists in the close_mint instruction where the request queue is not checked when closing a SingleAssetVault mint. The root cause is the conditional logic only enforcing queue checks for AccountType::TokenizedVault, omitting SingleAssetVault despite sharing similar invariants. An attacker or administrator could close the mint while pending requests remain in the queue, leading to stranded or unfulfilled user requests. This results in a loss of service for users with pending operations, though no direct fund loss occurs, limiting the impact to disruption of functionality for affected users.

findings.title: SingleAssetVault skips pending-queue gate in update_mint_apply_timelock.rs
findings.description: The vulnerability allows pending updates to be applied on a SingleAssetVault even when there are unfulfilled subscription or redemption requests in the queue. The cause is the absence of a queue check for SingleAssetVault in the update_mint_apply_timelock instruction, where the logic only enforces this gate for AccountType::TokenizedVault. An attacker with admin privileges could exploit this to apply configuration changes without first settling pending user requests, potentially leading to inconsistent state transitions or unfair treatment of queued users. The impact is low, as it does not result in fund loss but undermines the expected sequencing of operations and may affect user trust and fairness.

findings.title: Jupiter Swap is not blocked for SingleAssetVault
findings.description: The vulnerability arises because the jupiter_swap instruction does not explicitly block SingleAssetVault, allowing swaps of the base asset into other tokens if enabled in integration_acls. The root cause is the lack of a type check to prevent such integrations on SingleAssetVault, which is intended to hold only its base asset. An attacker could exploit this by enabling JupiterSwap and draining the base asset via swaps, causing the vault's AUM to be underpriced since price_single_asset_vault only accounts for the base-asset ATA balance. The impact is low, as it affects valuation accuracy and violates the design assumption of base-asset-only pricing, but does not directly lead to fund loss from the vault itself.
